name: 13830 · Oxford, NY
findings: ZIP 13830 (Oxford) has 15 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (62% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13830 (Oxford) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13830 (Oxford) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).
